title: Queued validation can wait indefinitely behind stale box reservations
body: The authorized live queue command was submitted for baseline build and launcher fixture preparation, but both stayed queued for more than 22 minutes with available host memory and no admission, output, timeout, or diagnostic; the lane had to cancel only its own wrappers. Suggested consolidation: add a bounded starvation diagnostic or reservation-health/status path so a lane can distinguish recoverable queue contention from a dead reservation without attempting a forbidden raw build.
